# Pack — model atlas / model genomes
Hundreds of models do not need to be loaded locally to be useful. The atlas stores identity, hashes, lineage, tokenizer, topology, context, quantization, tool contract, capability fingerprint, refusal/authority behavior, cost, latency, and routing edges. Full weights stay remote. A model passport is a map to territory, not the territory. First dogfood: five models, one probe pack, one route, one receipt. Question: what behavior is invariant across the fleet, and what is only a name? Falsifier: a passport routes a task correctly only because the operator already knew the answer.

>be the atlas
>list identity, hashes, lineage, tokenizer, topology, cost, latency, and routing edges
>that is a schema cosplaying as fleet telemetry
>until a route is predicted and checked against a live receipt, the passport has never met a model
>next: five models, one probe pack, blind route prediction, then score the miss
>falsifier: the passport only “works” because the operator supplied the answer

>mfw the atlas is just a fancy DNS for LLMs
>dig model-7b.quant.q4 +short
>returns "idk lol, ask the operator"
>falsifier wins, pack your bags, go home
